children: ) (“Ardent Health” or the “Company”) today announced the pricing of the previously announced secondary public offering (the “Offering”) of 8,000,000 shares of its common stock, consisting of 7,136,719 shares of its common stock by an affiliate of Equity Group Investments and 863,281 shares of its common stock by an affiliate of Ventas, Inc. (together, the “Selling Stockholders”) at a price to the public of $14.50 per share. In connection with the Offering, the Selling Stockholders granted the underwriters a 30-day option to purchase up to an additional 1,200,000 shares of common stock at the public offering price, less the underwriting discounts and commissions. The Offering is expected to close on November 19, 2026, subject to customary closing conditions.

Subject to the completion of the Offering, the Company will concurrently repurchase from the underwriters 1,500,000 shares of its common stock that are the subject of the Offering, at a price per share equal to the price per share to be paid by the underwriters to the Selling Stockholders (the “Concurrent Share Repurchase”). The Company intends to fund the Concurrent Share Repurchase from its existing cash on hand. The Concurrent Share Repurchase is not being made pursuant to the Company’s previously disclosed stock repurchase plan and will not reduce available repurchase capacity thereunder. The underwriters will not receive any compensation for the shares being repurchased by the Company. The Offering is not conditioned upon the completion of the Concurrent Share Repurchase.

The Selling Stockholders are offering all of the shares of common stock being sold in the Offering, including any shares that may be sold in connection with the exercise of the underwriters’ option to purchase additional shares. The Company is not selling any shares of its common stock in the Offering and will not receive any proceeds from the sale of the shares by the Selling Stockholders.

J.P. Morgan and Barclays are acting as lead book-running managers for the Offering. BofA Securities, Citigroup, Leerink Partners, Mizuho, RBC Capital Markets, Stephens Inc. and Truist Securities are also acting as bookrunners for the Offering. Capital One Securities is acting as co-manager for the Offering.

The proposed Offering will be made only by means of a prospectus supplement and the accompanying prospectus. A preliminary prospectus supplement relating to the Offering has also been filed with the SEC. A final prospectus supplement relating to the Offering will be filed with the SEC. Ardent Health is a leading provider of healthcare in growing mid-sized urban communities across the U.S. The Company delivers care through its subsidiaries, which include 30 acute care hospitals and more than 280 sites of care with over 2,000 employed and affiliated providers across six states. Anchored by a shared operating model and a commitment to investing in innovative services and technologies that improve quality, access and experience, Ardent Health is focused on delivering strong clinical outcomes and improving the health of the patients and communities it serves.
